title: What NOT To Do When You’re Fired From Your Job
description:
On November 3, 2021, the La Crosse Police Department assisted in taking a man into custody. The man was fired from his job and sent threatening messages to staff members at the company. Police showed up at his residence as the man was about to leave. He saw police, refused any commands, and went back into his residence making it unknown if he was armed or not...
